scope: Ki Blast Evasive category reconciliation after Batches 228-232

findings.details: The current Category:Ki Blast Evasives page's 23-item alphabetical listing omits Victory Cannon, while the current Evasive Skill reference explicitly includes Victory Cannon in its Ki Blast table and the individual Victory Cannon page categorizes it as Ki Blast Evasives.
findings.resolution: Retain Victory Cannon as Evasive / Ki Blast in research data, but flag category-index inconsistency instead of removing it.

findings.details: The current Evasive Skill reference states 18 Ki Blast Evasives are available for CaCs, while its table mixes CaC-accessible skills with cast-only entries and is internally inconsistent with the category index. Do not use 18 as the total category count.

source_notes: Current Fandom category and Evasive Skill reference disagree on Victory Cannon membership. The individual Victory Cannon page explicitly categorizes it as a Ki Blast Evasive, so the contradiction is preserved as a source/index conflict rather than silently normalizing one side.
